newsitem.title: USA: Delta Air Lines files for Chile route.
newsitem.headline: Delta Air Lines files for Chile route.

text.p: Delta Air Lines said Tuesday it filed an application with the U.S. Department of Transportation for authority to fly to Chile.
It said its application seeks approval to operate daily service from Atlanta with single-plane behind-gateway service to and from Cincinnati, to Santiago, possibly via intermediate points.
It proposes to start the service on December 15, pending governmental approvals, it said.
Delta recently received government approval to provide scheduled service to Brazil.

"This new service will build on Delta's Cincinnati-Atlanta to Brazil service, which is serving as the cornerstone for Delta's South American operations," said Vince Caminiti, Delta's senior vice president for sales and international operations.
